text:
elena: alert: spike of mTLS handshakes failing after midnight key policy change (11:34 UTC)
vikram: seeing KMS AccessDenied from cross-account decrypt attempts, proxies in acct-2222 hitting key in acct-1111
zoe: which policy changed? I applied a terraform keypolicy patch to tighten principals earlier
elena: logs show `AccessDeniedException: CallerNotPermitted` and `NotPrincipal` errors from KMS
infra-oncall: impact: ~85 failed handshakes across us-east-1 and eu-west-1, short retries caused downstream latency bumps
vikram: rolling back key policy now -> `aws kms put-key-policy --key-id arn:aws:kms:... --policy file://old-policy.json --region eu-west-1`
zoe: hold - can we add a scoped allow instead of full rollback? cross-account use is expected for proxies, just restrict to decrypt-only with conditions
security-bot: noticed tf plan removed `"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/proxy-kms"` from key policy; change merged in PR #4998 at 11:28 UTC
infra-oncall: rollback applied 11:39 UTC, handshakes recovered ~50s later, failures dropped to baseline
audit-bot: sampling: mtls_events at 1% globally; redaction hides `caller_arn` and `key_arn` by default, slow for triage
elena: followups: (1) make emergency retention: dump unredacted mtls_events for window [-15m,+15m] to secure-bucket (2) add CI lint to prevent keypolicy diffs that remove cross-account principals without `mtls-impact` signoff
vikram: policy suggestion for scoped allow: `Statement: {Effect:Allow, Principal: {AWS: "arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/proxy-kms"}, Action: ["kms:Decrypt"], Condition: {StringEquals: {"aws:SourceAccount":"222233334444","kms:ViaService":"kms.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com"}}}`
zoe: I'll draft that template and a terraform module `kms-crossaccount_scoped` with tests. Also add a canary job that runs cross-account decrypt before applying policy in prod
infra-oncall: sampling override request: set mtls_event sampling to 20% in affected regions for 8h -> will post override
security-bot: incident created INC-2026-0567; recommended artifacts: key policy diffs, cloudtrail KMS events, proxy logs, terraform plan, unredacted mtls bundle
elena: owners: @zoe to draft terraform+policy template, @vikram to author CI lint rule, @infra-oncall to run sampling override and create secure bundle. follow-up tomorrow 09:00 UTC for postmortem :thumbsup:
